Fits 15-es0000, 15m-es0000 and 15t-es000-series units, such as the 15-es0020ca, 15m-es0013dx and 15-es2050wm. HP sold this series with both 250-nit and 400-nit brightness options on the same panel size and connector, so fit is not affected by brightness — but if you're unsure of your exact model, send us your full model number or a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp before you order. 360-degree hinge supports laptop, tent, stand and tablet modes. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do I know this is the right variant for my Envy x360 15-es?
faqs.answer: The 15-es series (also badged 15m-es and 15t-es) shipped with a single FHD IPS touch panel across its SKUs, in either 250-nit or 400-nit brightness. Both use the same size, connector and touch layer, so this listing fits either. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us your full model number or a photo of the label under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it touch screen?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a multi-touch IPS panel with edge-to-edge glass, matching the Envy x360's 360-degree convertible hinge.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
